en.headline: Two-car crash on Sha Tin Road closes lanes and disrupts Lion Rock Tunnel
en.dek: A collision between two private cars on Thursday morning left one vehicle overturned and another on its side, forcing closures on Sha Tin Road towards Ma On Shan and intermittent shutdowns at the tunnel.
body: Police and the Transport Department responded to a traffic accident involving two private cars on Sha Tin Road near Pok Hong Shopping Centre and Bok Hong Estate at about 7:45 am on Thursday.

One car overturned onto its roof while the other ended on its side. Reports indicated one driver was injured and trapped briefly; two people felt unwell and were taken to Prince of Wales Hospital. One driver was later suspected of drink-driving.

The Transport Department said all lanes of Sha Tin Road towards Ma On Shan near Sun Tin Wai remained closed for a time, with traffic queues reaching as far as Waterloo Road in Kowloon Tong. The Lion Rock Tunnel towards Sha Tin faced intermittent closures, and congestion built in the area.

Drivers were advised to use alternative routes such as Tsing Sha Highway or Tate’s Cairn Tunnel. Later traffic reports indicated the main closures had been lifted by mid-morning, with residual congestion easing.

zh.headline: 沙田路兩私家車相撞翻側 往馬鞍山方向一度全線封閉
zh.dek: 周四早上約7時45分沙田路近博康商場兩部私家車相撞，一部四輪朝天、一部翻側，往馬鞍山方向道路封閉，獅子山隧道往沙田方向間封，車龍延至九龍塘。
body: 警方及運輸署接報，周四早上約7時45分沙田路往馬鞍山方向近博康邨及博康商場對開發生交通意外，涉及兩部私家車。
其中一部私家車撞至四輪朝天，另一部翻側路中。據報有司機受傷被困，兩人感到不適送往威爾斯親王醫院治理，其中一名司機其後涉酒後駕駛。
運輸署表示，沙田路往馬鞍山方向近新田圍全線一度封閉，車龍龍尾延伸至九龍塘窩打老道。獅子山隧道往沙田方向實施間歇性封閉，附近交通擠塞。
運輸署呼籲駕駛人士考慮改用青沙公路或大老山隧道。較後交通消息指主要封閉措施已於上午中段解除，餘下擠塞逐步消散。
